betaLB: Likelihood-Based Confidence Intervals for Regression Effect Sizes

Source: R/betaLB-package.R
betaLB-package.Rd

Generates profile likelihood confidence intervals for standardized regression coefficients and other effect sizes for models fitted by stats::lm() with independently sampled random regressors. The functions and arguments follow the betaSandwich package.

Standardized regression coefficients

BetaLB() estimates the standardized regression coefficients and their likelihood intervals. The argument type is "mvn" (multivariate normal theory) or "robust" (empirical fourth moments).

Functions of the standardized coefficients

RSqLB() (R-squared and adjusted R-squared), DiffBetaLB() (differences of standardized slopes), SCorLB() and SCorSqLB() (semipartial correlations), PCorLB() (squared partial correlations), DeltaRSqLB() (improvement in R-squared), and FSqLB() (Cohen's f-squared and local f-squared). These functions take the output of BetaLB().

Methods

The coef(), confint(), summary(), and print() methods are available for objects of class betalb and eslb. A covariance matrix is not defined for likelihood intervals, so vcov() stops with a message.

References

Dudgeon, P. (2017). Some improvements in confidence intervals for standardized regression coefficients. Psychometrika, 82(4), 928–951. doi:10.1007/s11336-017-9563-z
